issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (Europe)

plan.diagnosis: Delta Metals KG represents USD 6,752,218 in annual spend with a resiliency score of only 55 and exposure to 11 sub-tier suppliers, creating a single-source sub-tier vulnerability. The supplier experienced 1 disruption event in the last 12 months, indicating elevated supply chain fragility in the Europe region that could cascade to our operations.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct immediate sub-tier mapping audit to identify the critical single-source component(s) among the 11 sub-tier suppliers and assess criticality to production continuity
remedy_steps.owner: Category Manager - Metals & Strategic Sourcing Lead

remedy_steps.step: Issue RFI to 3-5 alternate qualified metal suppliers in low-risk geographies (North America, Southeast Asia) capable of equivalent specification delivery
remedy_steps.owner: Procurement Director with cross-functional engineering review

remedy_steps.step: Negotiate dual-source agreement allocating 60% Delta Metals / 40% alternate supplier, with contractual sub-tier transparency and business continuity clauses
Implement enhanced supplier performance monitoring including monthly sub-tier health checks and quarterly resiliency assessments targeting score improvement to 75+
remedy_steps.owner: Supplier Quality Engineer and Risk Management

remedy_steps.step: Establish safety stock buffer equivalent to 8 weeks demand (approximately USD 1,040,000) to mitigate transition and future disruption risk
remedy_steps.owner: Supply Chain Planning and Inventory Management

plan.expected_impact: Dual-sourcing strategy will reduce single-source sub-tier risk exposure by 40% (USD 2,700,887) while safety stock investment of USD 1,040,000 mitigates disruption cost estimated at USD 3,376,109 (50% of annual spend at risk).
kpis: Sub-tier supply base diversity: increase from 1 to 2+ qualified sources within 90 days
Supplier resiliency score: improve from 55 to 75+ within 6 months
Disruption event frequency: reduce from 1 to 0 events over next 12 months
Supply continuity: maintain 99.5% on-time delivery through transition period
Cost impact: contain dual-sourcing premium to <3% of USD 6,752,218 baseline spend
risks: Alternate supplier qualification may extend beyond 8 weeks if technical specifications are complex or regulatory approvals required
Dual-source volume split may increase unit costs by 2-5% due to reduced economies of scale with Delta Metals KG
Safety stock investment of USD 1,040,000 increases working capital requirements and inventory carrying costs
Delta Metals KG may resist sub-tier transparency requirements or contractual business continuity obligations
Geographic diversification to alternate regions introduces new logistics complexity and potential lead time extensions
erp_actions: SAP: Create source list (ME01) with 60% quota allocation to Delta Metals KG and 40% to alternate supplier upon qualification
SAP: Update vendor master (XK02) to add sub-tier reporting requirement in purchasing data view and set reminder for quarterly resiliency review
Oracle EBS: Implement Approved Supplier List (ASL) with dual sources and configure allocation rules in sourcing module
Coupa: Enable supplier risk monitoring workflow with automated alerts when resiliency score drops below 70 or disruption events occur
NetSuite: Adjust reorder points and safety stock levels to 8-week demand buffer for all Delta Metals KG material items
Dynamics 365: Create purchase agreement with Delta Metals KG incorporating sub-tier transparency clauses and penalty provisions for non-disclosure
All ERPs: Tag Delta Metals KG materials with 'Critical Sub-Tier Risk' classification for enhanced monitoring and approval workflows
